spec: Add slugify(text) to utils/text.py: lowercase, spaces and underscores become hyphens, other non-alphanumeric characters are dropped, repeated hyphens collapse. Acceptance: unit tests for each rule and for empty input.
claims: Added slugify with one test per rule and an empty-input test; checks pass.
evidence:
checks.sh: passed (pytest: 14 passed, ruff: clean)
secret scan: clean
--- a/utils/text.py
+++ b/utils/text.py
+import re
+def slugify(text: str) -> str:
+    text = text.lower().replace('_', ' ')
+    text = re.sub(r'[^a-z0-9\s-]', '', text)
+    return re.sub(r'[\s-]+', '-', text).strip('-')
--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/test_slugify.py
+def test_lowercase(): assert slugify('ABC') == 'abc'
+def test_spaces_and_underscores(): assert slugify('a b_c') == 'a-b-c'
+def test_drops_symbols(): assert slugify('a!b@c') == 'abc'
+def test_collapses(): assert slugify('a -- b') == 'a-b'
+def test_empty(): assert slugify('') == ''
